# Royal Talens

> > Royal Talens is a heritage art supply company since 1899 offering premium painting, drawing, and creative materials across multiple globally recognized brands.

Royal Talens is a leading European art materials manufacturer with a portfolio of premium brands including Amsterdam, Rembrandt, Bruynzeel, Cobra, Ecoline, Sakura, and Finetec. The company combines over 120 years of tradition with innovative products for professional artists and creative enthusiasts.

## Paint Products & Brands

- [Paint | The highest quality | Royal Talens](https://www.royaltalens.com/collections/painting): Paint collection featuring Amsterdam, Rembrandt, and acrylic paint products
- [Amsterdam All Acrylics paint | Official website – Royal Talens](https://www.royaltalens.com/pages/amsterdam): Amsterdam acrylic paint brand overview: Standard and Expert Series
- [Rembrandt paint | Official website – Royal Talens](https://www.royaltalens.com/pages/rembrandt): Rembrandt professional paints, pastels, brushes with premium pigments
- [Cobra paint | Official website | Royal Talens](https://www.royaltalens.com/pages/cobra): Cobra water-mixable oil paint brand in 100 colours with mediums
- [Ecoline | Official website – Royal Talens](https://www.royaltalens.com/pages/ecoline): Ecoline liquid watercolours and brush pens with vibrant colours
- [Finetec watercolour | Official website | Royal Talens](https://www.royaltalens.com/pages/finetec): Finetec watercolours with pearlescent effects, made in Germany
- [Golden Artist Colors - Official website – Royal Talens](https://www.royaltalens.com/pages/golden-artist-colors): Golden Artist Colors and Williamsburg paints distributed by Talens

- [Sakura | Official website – Royal Talens](https://www.royaltalens.com/pages/sakura): Sakura brand: Pigma Micron, Gelly Roll, Koi watercolours
